source: P7 historical arithmetic model, restricted to N2
geometry: The three N2 STEP hashes match the frozen P8 geometry. Source manifest hash refers to the prior P6 design manifest, not this P11 package manifest.
model_difference: P7 uses a proximal roof point at near+inset (X28.5 at zero inset). P8 distributes a finite roof patch X28.5–29.5 with centroid X29.0. The two studies have different contact assumptions; they must not be combined as one validated contact solution.
